sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro preview — Gemini API model documentation
sources.evidence: The exact standard preview ID has a 1,048,576-token input limit, text/image/video/audio/PDF inputs, text output, thinking and function calling. The customtools endpoint is separately identified. Documentation updated October 9, 2026.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro — Google Cloud model documentation
sources.evidence: Google Cloud lists the standard preview on February 19, 2026 and its customtools endpoint on February 23. The Gemini API changelog records both endpoints on February 19; the later Cloud date does not establish the earliest customtools release. Confirms standard-model context and capabilities.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro — Model Card
sources.evidence: Identifies a Gemini 3-series multimodal reasoning model based on Gemini 3 Pro. Its Architecture section explicitly delegates to the Gemini 3 Pro card. Describes Google product/API distribution under service terms; reports no numeric total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card (updated May 2026)
sources.evidence: This is the architecture reference linked by the exact 3.1 Pro card. Page 3 describes a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer with native multimodal input and per-token expert routing. It does not give total or active parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The service terms linked from the exact model card govern API access and prohibit extraction or replication of underlying models and parameter weights, supporting proprietary distribution rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash — Model Card (May 2026)
sources.evidence: Later first-party comparison card includes an exact Gemini 3.1 Pro column for capabilities, but contains no total/active parameter disclosure for it. Flash specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash — Model Card (July 2026)
sources.evidence: Later first-party comparison table includes Gemini 3.1 Pro, without total or active parameter counts. Its benchmark and price entries do not establish model size.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon — Model Card (October 2026)
sources.evidence: Later successor card compares safety results against Gemini 3.1 Pro, without disclosing its total or active parameter counts. Argon is explicitly a new model, so its specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: SFT Drives Gemini’s Safety Properties
sources.publisher: Google DeepMind Language Model Interpretability team (Josh Engels, Arthur Conmy, Bilal Chughtai and Neel Nanda)
sources.evidence: June 13, 2026 author research update explicitly studies pretraining-only, SFT and production Gemini 3.1 Pro. The training/interpretability study adds no numeric model size or architecture detail.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview record
sources.evidence: Original catalog source inspected as a lead. Its name and endpoint identify this standard preview; technical values were checked independently against Google documentation.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes — February 19, 2026
sources.evidence: The February 19, 2026 entry explicitly launches gemini-3.1-pro-preview-customtools alongside Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview.

name.note: Official endpoint title and model ID identify the standard preview.

developer.note: Google DeepMind publishes and develops the model; Google is the catalog developer label.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the documented Gemini 3 Pro family and 3.1 Pro dependency.

release_date.note: The standard preview launched February 19 in both the Gemini API changelog and Cloud versions table.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is through Google services/API under proprietary terms, without a downloadable open checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive model-access classification under Gemini service terms; documentation and sample-code licenses are separate.

parameters_b.note: No numeric total in the exact card, linked architecture card, later exact-model comparisons or inspected training/interpretability study.

active_parameters_b.note: Sparse routing is disclosed, but no activated-per-token count. No count is inferred from siblings, performance or research features.

architecture.note: Exact card explicitly delegates architecture to Gemini 3 Pro: sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer, not an unsupported family inference.

context_window.note: Exact API input-token limit; separate output cap is 65,536 tokens.

modalities.note: Exact endpoint supports these input formats and text output; no image or audio generation.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly supported by the standard endpoint.
